The '''Survival Burger''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. It is also cooked by [[Gus]] during the [[Stardew Valley Fair]] and can be eaten for free. 1-2 Survival Burger may occasionally be found in [[Supply Crate]]s on the [[Farm Maps#Beach|Beach Farm]] if the player has not upgraded the [[Farmhouse]] yet.

Survival Burger may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]].  5 Survival Burgers may occasionally be found in a [[Skull Cavern#Treasure Rooms|treasure room]] in the Skull Cavern.

'''Note''': this recipe is [[Cooking#Profitable Recipes|profitable]] - it will always result in profit when using the lowest quality ingredients as well as [[Bread]] made from [[Wheat Flour]] made in the [[Mill]].

==Tailoring==
Survival Burger is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Burger Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt247.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].
